gold_tool: gopls v0.23.0 rename -w of each flag type's method (go1.26.3, GOTOOLCHAIN=local) + gofmt on changed files
instruction: The per-flag accessor `ValueFromContext(ctx *Context)` is too long for how often it is used. Rename the `ValueFromContext` method to `Get` on every flag type that defines it (`BoolFlag`, `StringFlag`, `IntSliceFlag`, `TimestampFlag`, `GenericFlag` and all the other built-in flag types). The rename must cover every method declaration and every call site, including tests. Behavior must not change: the project must still build and its tests must pass.
notes: 15 separate concrete methods (not an interface), renamed one gopls call each. gopls output matches the real commit on .go files modulo gofmt alignment (git diff -w empty). No look-alikes of ValueFromContext exist.
